tweets: Mīnākṣī Amman Temple, Madurai — fourteen gopurams rise over this temple city, their stucco surfaces alive with some 33,000 painted figures of gods, sages and beasts. The tallest, the southern tower, soars to about 170 feet, raised in 1559 under the Nāyaka kings.
